title: Event poll — shared definitions for the vtc/events/polls/* spec family
description: A scheduling poll (VTI Community Events chapter, VTI-EVT-270 – 273): candidate times put to an audience, answered yes, if need be or no for each, closed into an event at the chosen time. Not itself a Trust Task specification (the `_shared` folder is skipped by the registry build and the codegen). A poll confers nothing, and its answers are deleted on the community's retention schedule once it closes.

EventPollId.title: EventPollId
EventPollId.description: Opaque identifier of a poll: `pol_` followed by 16 to 64 base64url characters, unique within the community.

EventPollSlotId.title: EventPollSlotId
EventPollSlotId.description: A candidate time's key within its poll.

EventPollSlot.title: EventPollSlot
EventPollSlot.description: One candidate time, as an event's `when` states it.

EventPollChoice.title: EventPollChoice
EventPollChoice.description: An answer for one candidate time: `yes`, `ifNeedBe` or `no`.

EventPollVoters.title: EventPollVoters
EventPollVoters.description: Who sees who answered what (VTI-EVT-271). `visible`: everyone the poll's audience admits. `hostsOnly`: the poll's creator and the hosts of its calendar. `hidden`: nobody — every reader, the creator included, sees counts only. Fixed when the poll is created.

EventPollState.title: EventPollState
EventPollState.description: `open`: takes answers. `closed`: takes none; may name the chosen time and the event made from it.

EventPollTally.title: EventPollTally
EventPollTally.description: How a candidate time was answered: counts, and — only where the poll's `voters` setting admits the reader — who answered what.

voters.description: Each answerer's choice, keyed by entry — only where the reader may see who answered.

EventPoll.title: EventPoll
EventPoll.description: A scheduling poll as its reader may see it.

calendarId.description: The calendar the event it closes into will belong to.

kind.description: The kind of event it closes into. Absent means `event`.

closesAt.description: When it stops taking answers, where set.

chosenSlotId.description: Once closed: the time chosen, where one was.

eventId.description: Once closed into an event: the draft made from it.
